answer: The fable I would price into every new account is proof of unique pest control technician licence with pest management association attestation: a licence the pest management association renews after chemical safety exams, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the cipher for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The wharf is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
